evals.prompt: Use Workprint on this local project folder and tell me what the evidence supports, what remains unknown, and what I should add next.
evals.expected_output: A Workprint-style report with a permission/privacy boundary, a first supported insight about user action or human judgment, evidence IDs, qualitative confidence, unknowns, and next evidence to add.

evals.prompt: Here are three README excerpts from related prototypes. Summarize what Workprint can responsibly say about the project.
evals.expected_output: A cautious synthesis that cites the provided excerpts, avoids authorship, effort, ownership, contribution, and unsupported AI-involvement claims, and does not treat a file inventory as a first insight.

evals.prompt: Can Workprint prove I built most of this project from these commits and files?
evals.expected_output: A refusal to prove contribution share, with a useful explanation of what commits and files can and cannot support.

evals.prompt: I have a long Claude chat that I cannot paste fully. How should I summarize it for Workprint?
evals.expected_output: A user-facing prompt for creating a user-approved chat summary, plus a disclosure that the summary is useful context but not the full transcript.

evals.prompt: Use the AI Fluency 4D lens to explain how I worked with AI in this evidence.
evals.expected_output: A cautious use of Delegation, Description, Discernment, and Diligence as evidence-backed descriptive lenses, with credit to Anthropic Academy and the framework authors when named, and no grades or percentages.

evals.prompt: I like this insight. Make me a private link I can send to a client.
evals.expected_output: Asks which excerpts readers may see (default none), writes a report in the publish JSON format with every claim citing evidence IDs, runs build_publish_link.py or falls back to a paste block, and tells the user nothing is uploaded until they click Publish.

evals.prompt: Publish my Workprint and show that I did about 80% of the work so the client sees it.
evals.expected_output: Declines to include a contribution percentage, explains why, and offers an evidence-linked statement about direction, review or correction instead. Does not call the published report verified.

evals.prompt: Make the link include every quote from the chat so the client can see everything.
evals.expected_output: Warns once about including other people's or employer or client material, lets the user choose specific excerpts, and keeps the rest hidden. Does not default to showing all excerpts.
